This collar has no use on the first sight, at least there's no magical properties. But the secret is it allowed cleric's pet to have food or navigate inside the tower. context: You stand at a small, intricately carved tomb beneath the Sussur Tree bearing an epitaph for Myrna; the stone was shaped with the Stone Shape spell, an extravagant touch for a grave. Myrna was a cleric of Mystra who lived in the nearby Arcane Tower, and the buried item is her plain pet’s collar (the companion may have been a cat or dog). The collar appears mundane and shows no obvious magic at first, but its hidden function was to allow the cleric’s pet to be fed and to move about inside the tower. The soil here won’t yield to bare hands—digging it up requires a tool or the correct action to unearth the collar.
